title: Spider-Man & Bruce Banner - Mutation and Survival
description: Luyện nghe chuyên sâu IELTS qua đoạn hội thoại giữa Peter, Bruce Banner, May và các nhân vật khác về sự biến đổi gen và hiểm họa.

mcqQuestions.q: What does Peter mean when he states: 'I'm losing my mind. I am totally out of control.'?
options: Peter is physically lost in a new city and cannot navigate.
Peter is experiencing extreme mental overload and losing his psychological stability.
Peter has forgotten where he put his belongings.
Peter is joking about his poor grades at school.

mcqQuestions.q: What does Bruce imply when saying: 'If you see me with this off, run.'?
options: Bruce is warning that a dangerous transformation will happen if the device is removed.
Bruce is playing a game of tag with Peter.
Bruce is showing off a fashion accessory.
Bruce wants Peter to steal the device from him.

mcqQuestions.q: What does Metzger refer to with: 'It appears we’re faced with a threat we can’t control. One we can't even see.'?
options: The speakers are discussing a visible natural disaster like a storm.
The speakers are talking about an invisible, uncontrollable danger or microscopic/alien menace.
The speakers are playing an invisible board game.
The speakers are complaining about a lack of internet connection.

mcqQuestions.q: What does the line 'You're the only one who can sense it' suggest about Peter?
options: Peter has special perceptive abilities that others lack regarding this threat.
Peter has a very strong sense of smell compared to others.
Peter is the only one who refuses to believe the danger exists.
Peter invented the threat himself.

mcqQuestions.q: What is the core message of May's advice: '...but the people who love you... love you because you're you'?
options: People only love others when they become powerful superheroes.
True affection is unconditional and values your authentic self, not your status or power.
Family members only love you if you follow their strict rules.
Self-love is more important than caring for friends.

mcqQuestions.q: What does May emphasize in: 'Never forget that... no matter how powerful you become.'?
options: Power always corrupts everyone eventually.
You should use your strength to dominate others.
Humility and your core identity matter more than acquiring supreme power.
Physical strength is the only thing that protects you in high school.
